hypothesis: A bounded materialization design can convert supported source evidence into executable-v2 candidate rows without biasing or over-expanding the corpus.

design routes to implementation without materializing rows reset rollout measured rollout training replay PPO ranking or paper-level claims

design makes ranking paper-level or level3 self-ID claims
decision_rule: M1858 passes if it designs bounded materialization without creating rows, rerunning mining, reset, rollout, ranking, or paper-level claims.
